Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for %cast_duration% seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations.

tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_meepo_divided_we_st:
Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls.

Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them %dps_penalty_pct%%% less effective.

If any Meepo dies, they all die.
All Meepos have a stackable aura that increases nearby Meepos' attack speed by %support_group_attack_speed_pct%%% and armor by %support_group_armor%. Radius: %support_radius%.

Can now be upgraded at level %required_level% and every %bonus_levels_between_upgrades% levels afterwards to a max level of %max_level%. Duplicate Meepos receive %main_meepo_stats_pct%%% of the main Meepo's bonus attributes.

tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_meepo_geomancy_Desc:
Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain. Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.

If there is a tree within %tree_radius% range, he receives %tree_regen% HP regen.

If he is standing on dirt, he receives %dirt_move_speed%%% bonus movement speed.

If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by %water_move_slow%%% for %water_slow_duration% seconds.
tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_meepo_geomancy_Note: Dirt includes any terrain that is not water.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_meepo_bio: "If you ask me, life is all about who you know and what you can find. When you live up in the Riftshadow Ruins, just finding food can be tough. So you need to cut corners, you need to scrounge, you need to know your strengths. Some of the beasts up there can kill you, so you need a way to trap the weak and duck the strong. On the upside, the ruins have history, and history is worth a lot to some people. There used to be a palace there, where they had all these dark rituals. Bad stuff. If you survived the ceremony, they would shatter a crystal and split your soul into pieces. They made great art though! Sculptures and such. Let me tell you: sometimes you stumble onto some of those old carvings. Take a pack full of those to town and sell them, then get yourself food for a few weeks. If luck is really on your side, you might find a Riftshadow crystal. Get it appraised and start asking around. Someone always knows some crazy fool looking for this kind of thing. If all else fails, sell it to a Magus the next time one's in town. They love that stuff. Still, whatever you do, be careful handling those crystals. You do not want one to go off on you. It really hurts."

qualifications.raw: [[Roshan]] is innately immune to this ability.

* Considers enemy {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, {{M|Couriers}} as heroes, {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# The {{M|pure}} {{M|spell damage}}.
*# Restore the attacking {{hi|Meepo}} Meepo's {{M|health}}.
*# Restore all {{A|Meepo|Meepo Clones}}' health.
*# The attacking {{hi|Meepo}} Meepo's attack instance.

* {{Symbol|bonus ls}}
** [[Lifesteal]]s for the full value regardless of the damage instance value, this includes from the following sources:
*** {{M|Damage Negation}} sources.
*** {{M|Damage Block}} sources.
*** {{M|Incoming damage}} manipulation sources on the attacked enemy unit.
** Does not lifesteal from the following units:
*** {{M|Buildings}}
*** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
** Does not affect the following units:
*** {{M|Allied units|x}}.

fields.name: interacts
mechanics
fields.value:
* Can only be cast on the following Meepos:
** The self-casting Meepo.
** The {{Symbol|Meepo|Prime}} Prime.
** Own and allied {{M|clones}} of the caster.
** Own and allied {{M|illusions}} of the caster.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} fully stack, enemy units within both the start and end location can be affected twice.

* All ability targeting functionalities do not {{M|disjoint}} incoming {{M|projectiles}}.

* Poof has three targeting functionalities:
** {{M|Doubletap}} self-casts Poof on the casting Meepo.
** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
*** When unit-targeted, the casting Meepo Poofs to the selected Meepo.
*** Can Poof to {{M|hidden}} or {{M|invulnerable}} Meepos.
** {{Symbol|Target|Point}} or {{Symbol|Target|Ground}}
*** When ground-targeted, the Meepo closest to the ground-targeted location is chosen upon the completion of the ability's {{M|cast point}}, which can be the same Meepo who casts Poof.

* {{M|Alt-Cast}} activated modifies the following targeting functionalities:
** Activating it on any Meepo, changes the ability functionality on all Meepos.
** Neither can Poof to {{M|hidden}} nor {{M|invulnerable}} Meepos.
** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
*** When unit-targeted, all Meepos will cast Poof on the unit-targeted Meepo, if able, including the {{M|doubletap}} function.
** {{Symbol|Target|Point}} or {{Symbol|Target|Ground}}
*** When ground-targeted, all Meepos except the casting Meepo will Poof to the Meepo nearest to the ground-targeted location, if able.
**** Interrupts the casting Meepo's actions regardless.

* {{cf|aghnotes}} The {{A|Meepo|MegaMeepo}} Poof damage is defined as:
** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|[[Spell Damage|SpellDmg]] × f(Stacked[[Divided We Stand|Meepos]])}}

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
[[File:Dota2 Meepo HUD icon.png|thumb|250px|The currently selected Meepo is highlighted.]]

* The Prime and its clones are each represented respectively on the top left corner of the screen.
** When a certain Meepo is selected, its icon becomes brighter, when it takes damage, its icon glows in red.

* {{Symbol|Meepo|Prime}}
** When the Prime respawns with {{M|reincarnation}} sources, all Clones respawn next to the Prime.

* {{Symbol|Meepo|Clones}}
** The {{M|Clones}} always spawn with 100% {{M|current health}} and {{M|current mana}} next to the {{Symbol|Meepo|Prime}} Prime, even when leveling the ability up from a clone.
** The {{G|res neutral min time}}-second min {{M|respawn}} time does not apply if Meepo is {{M|forced kill|text=force killed}} when any of the Clones die to {{M|neutral creeps}}.
** The Clone's attributes corresponds to the Prime's.
*** However, the Clones themselves are still independently and individually subjected to other attribute loss sources.
** Stack multiplicatively with other {{M|magic resistance}} sources.

* Meepo gains 100% of the experience from Hero Kills or Assists as long as at least one Meepo is in range.
** Multiple Meepos within experience range does not increase the amount gained.
* All other experience gained by any Meepo is divided by the number of Meepos.
** Each Meepo gains experience independently.

fields.name: miscnotes

claims.value: Meepo Summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls.
If any of the clones die, all Meepos die.

Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them {{#var:Divided We Stand type2 value1}} less effective.
Codependent: Armor and attack speed increased by other nearby Meepos.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_meepo
data.bio_loc: "If you ask me, life is all about who you know and what you can find. When you live up in the Riftshadow Ruins, just finding food can be tough. So you need to cut corners, you need to scrounge, you need to know your strengths. Some of the beasts up there can kill you, so you need a way to trap the weak and duck the strong. On the upside, the ruins have history, and history is worth a lot to some people. There used to be a palace there, where they had all these dark rituals. Bad stuff. If you survived the ceremony, they would shatter a crystal and split your soul into pieces. They made great art though! Sculptures and such. Let me tell you: sometimes you stumble onto some of those old carvings. Take a pack full of those to town and sell them, then get yourself food for a few weeks. If luck is really on your side, you might find a Riftshadow crystal. Get it appraised and start asking around. Someone always knows some crazy fool looking for this kind of thing. If all else fails, sell it to a Magus the next time one's in town. They love that stuff. Still, whatever you do, be careful handling those crystals. You do not want one to go off on you. It really hurts."
data.hype_loc: By summoning up to five permanent copies of himself, Meepo can fight from every front at once. Spreading his clones throughout the battlefield, when an enemy is found, he binds his foe, gathers his selves with an explosive teleport, then buries what remains.

abilities.name: meepo_earthbind
abilities.desc_loc: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.
abilities.lore_loc: Catching dinner in the Riftshadow Ruins can be quite the task.
notes_loc: Does not work on Debuff Immune units or Roshan.

abilities.name: meepo_poof
abilities.desc_loc:
Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for %cast_duration% seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations.

If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
abilities.lore_loc: Sometimes breaking one of the Riftshadow Crystals can be just the trick for getting yourself out of a bind.  Or your other self.
notes_loc: Can be cast through the minimap.

abilities.name: meepo_ransack
abilities.desc_loc:
Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.

Reduced to 60% against creeps.
abilities.lore_loc: So you gonna need that, or...?
notes_loc: Amount healed is amplified by Health Restoration Amplification

abilities.name: meepo_petrify
abilities.desc_loc:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for %duration%s. Restores %hp_restore%%% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: meepo_megameepo
abilities.desc_loc:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a %radius% radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains %stats_pct%%% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

 When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals %poof_damage_factor%%% more damage for each Meepo on top.

abilities.name: meepo_divided_we_stand
abilities.desc_loc:
Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls.

Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them %dps_penalty_pct%%% less effective.

If any Meepo dies, they all die.
facets_loc: Can now be upgraded at level %required_level% and every %bonus_levels_between_upgrades% levels afterwards to a max level of %max_level%. Duplicate Meepos receive %main_meepo_stats_pct%%% of the main Meepo's bonus attributes.
All Meepos have a stackable aura that increases nearby Meepos' attack speed by %support_group_attack_speed_pct%%% and armor by %support_group_armor%. Radius: %support_radius%.

abilities.name: meepo_geomancy
abilities.desc_loc:
Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain. Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.

If there is a tree within %tree_radius% range, he receives %tree_regen% HP regen.

If he is standing on dirt, he receives %dirt_move_speed%%% bonus movement speed.

If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by %water_move_slow%%% for %water_slow_duration% seconds.
notes_loc: Dirt includes any terrain that is not water.

abilities.name: meepo_megameepo_fling
abilities.desc_loc: In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a %AbilityCastRange% range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_meepo_4
talents.name_loc: Earthbind grants True Strike on Targets
